insight.title: GPS Satellites Have No Idea You Exist
insight.subtitle: Why the world's most famous tracking system is entirely blind to you.

sections.text: Every time you use your phone to navigate, you assume satellites are tracking you from space. But those multi-million dollar machines are completely blind—they have no idea where you are.

GPS satellites only broadcast one thing: the time. They are just giant, screaming clocks in space. Your phone listens to their shouts, calculates the delay, and figures out your location all by itself.
Because it is a one-way radio broadcast, a billion people can use GPS at the exact same time. The sky never gets overloaded, because space isn't listening to you.
Space isn't watching you; your phone is just listening.
